reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low, and a named lab with the batch report behind a QR code is more than most TikTok Shop supplements give me. The launch price of $24.99 and the money-back guarantee make one box an easy thing to try.
objection: Will I actually feel a difference? Magnesium is slow and subtle, and I would not know if it is the capsules or just a better week.
